title: Bharjari
desc: Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.

title: Clap
